headline: 234 caps, 146 goals: Ronaldo announces Portugal retirement
summary: The 41-year-old football legend will hand back the iconic number 7 shirt after the November international break.
details: Cristiano Ronaldo has announced his intention to retire from the Portuguese national team. The announcement was made via a social media post on Thursday.
The 41-year-old star confirmed that he will officially hand back the number 7 shirt following the conclusion of the November international break.
Ronaldo's legacy with the national team is unmatched, having made 234 appearances for Portugal.
He leaves the international stage as the all-time record holder for both international appearances and goals, with 146 goals scored.
caption:
The end of an era. Cristiano Ronaldo is stepping away from the Portuguese national team.

Cristiano Ronaldo has announced his intention to retire from the Portuguese national team. The announcement was made via a social media post on Thursday.

The 41-year-old star confirmed that he will officially hand back the number 7 shirt following the conclusion of the November international break.

Ronaldo's legacy with the national team is unmatched, having made 234 appearances for Portugal.

He leaves the international stage as the all-time record holder for both international appearances and goals, with 146 goals scored.

headline: Pori Moni gets bail after surrendering in assault case
summary: The actress allegedly snatched a reporter's phone and verbally abused journalists while her security guards reportedly injured a court visitor.
details: Actress Pori Moni surrendered to the Dhaka Chief Judicial Magistrate Court on Thursday and was granted bail on a Tk 500 bond.
The surrender follows a case filed by businessman Nasir Uddin Mahmud over allegations of assault, vandalism, and intimidation, which PBI reports substantiated the claims against her.
Chaos erupted at the court premises as Pori Moni was escorted by around 11 security guards in black and several others in civilian clothes.
During the commotion, Pori Moni allegedly snatched the mobile phone of Samakal multimedia reporter Robiul Hossain while he was recording a video.
The actress is also accused of verbally abusing journalists as she left the court premises after securing her bail.
Additionally, a court visitor named Sujan Chandra Moni Das sustained a head injury and was seen bleeding after being pushed by the actress's security guards.
The incident occurred as the actress's security detail formed a cordon to restrict the movement of people and journalists trying to capture the footage.
caption:
Pori Moni secures bail, but the court premises turn chaotic as she allegedly snatches a reporter's phone and her guards injure a visitor.

Actress Pori Moni surrendered to the Dhaka Chief Judicial Magistrate Court on Thursday and was granted bail on a Tk 500 bond.

The surrender follows a case filed by businessman Nasir Uddin Mahmud over allegations of assault, vandalism, and intimidation, which PBI reports substantiated the claims against her.

Chaos erupted at the court premises as Pori Moni was escorted by around 11 security guards in black and several others in civilian clothes.

During the commotion, Pori Moni allegedly snatched the mobile phone of Samakal multimedia reporter Robiul Hossain while he was recording a video.

The actress is also accused of verbally abusing journalists as she left the court premises after securing her bail.

Additionally, a court visitor named Sujan Chandra Moni Das sustained a head injury and was seen bleeding after being pushed by the actress's security guards.

The incident occurred as the actress's security detail formed a cordon to restrict the movement of people and journalists trying to capture the footage.

#PoriMoni #Bangladesh #Dhaka #EntertainmentNews #CourtCase

Source: Prothom Alo, bdnews24.com
